subject: Checkout fails after retrying payment
content: When a user's initial payment attempt fails (e.g. insufficient funds), they retry with a different card. The checkout enters a retry loop and eventually fails with 'PaymentRetryError: max retries exceeded' even when the second card is valid. Customer reports this started after the v2.4.1 deploy on Jan 14.

subject: Webhook replay causes duplicate notification
content: When a webhook event is replayed after a delivery failure, the notification service sends duplicate emails and Slack messages to the affected user. Multiple GLOBEX users reported receiving 3-4 copies of the same notification following the Nov 14 infrastructure event. Replay appears to bypass the idempotency check.

subject: Search results ignore archived filter
content: When a user applies the 'exclude archived' filter in the search UI, archived records still appear in the result set. The filter value is present in the query params (archived=false) but does not appear to be passed to the backend search service. Reproducible on all environments.

subject: User invite email links to expired token
content: Newly invited users receive an onboarding email with a sign-up link. The link contains a token that expires after 24 hours, but emails are sometimes delayed 24-48 hours due to the SES queue backlog, causing the token to be expired by the time the user clicks it. Affects approximately 12% of new invites this week.

subject: Dashboard metrics lag after deploy
content: After each production deployment, dashboard metrics (active users, request latency, error rate) stop updating for 5-15 minutes. Metrics resume automatically but the gap causes confusion during post-deploy monitoring windows. The on-call team has been manually reassuring stakeholders after each deploy.
